display.purpose: Page titles on settings, profile, and video detail views. Never on the feed.

headline.purpose: Section headers in side panels and drawer titles.

title.purpose: Video card titles in the feed. Two-line clamp. The most-read text on the platform.

body.purpose: Feed descriptions, comments, profile bios. 15px floor for running text.

label.purpose: Form labels, action button text, timestamps, metadata. The workhorse of the chrome.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Card rest state. Barely perceptible lift. Also used for avatar subtle depth.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Card hover state. Applied on mouse-over, removed on mouse-out. 200ms transition.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Modal, drawer, and toast. The only structural shadow. Says 'this surface is above everything.'

shadows.name: pink-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button rest glow. Intensifies on hover to oklch(0.62 0.21 4 / 0.38).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for interactive state transitions (140–160ms). Expo-out character: fast start, gentle settle.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Slight overshoot easing for entrance animations (toast slide-down, drawer open).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action. Pink gradient with glow shadow. Used for submit, publish, send, and login.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; font: 600 14px 'Noto Sans SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.62 0.21 4), oklch(0.55 0.23 8)); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px oklch(0.62 0.21 4 / 0.28); transition: all 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0.62 0.21 4 / 0.38); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3.5px oklch(0.88 0.07 4 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96) translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary or toolbar action. No background until hover. Used for close buttons, filter toggles, and supplementary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { appearance: none; font: 600 14px 'Noto Sans SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.32 0.01 270); transition: all 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.008 10); color: oklch(0.16 0.01 270); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3.5px oklch(0.88 0.07 4 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action button. Warm red tint background with danger-colored text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { appearance: none; font: 600 14px 'Noto Sans SC', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.90 0.02 22); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; background: oklch(0.97 0.02 22); color: oklch(0.54 0.21 22); transition: all 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.04 22); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3.5px oklch(0.88 0.07 4 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Skeleton Loader
components.description: Shimmer placeholder for async content. Matches the shape of the content it replaces.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.90 0.01 270) 25%, oklch(0.85 0.01 270) 50%, oklch(0.90 0.01 270) 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 1.4s infinite; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-skeleton-circle { border-radius: 9999px; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { 0% { background-position: 200% 0; } 100% { background-position: -200% 0; } }

narrative.overview:
ShortVideo is a short-video feed platform disguised as a precision tool. The feed scrolls like a well-tuned terminal: fast, dense, information-first. Every interaction lands in under 150ms. Rounded corners and a soft pink accent are the only hints that this isn't a developer tool — it's a B站-inspired content engine dressed in utilitarian chrome.

The system rejects decorative excess. Pink appears on primary actions, active navigation, and focus rings — nowhere else. Cards are white rectangles on a warm-tinted background. Depth comes from tonal contrast, not shadow. Shadows are reserved for the two moments that genuinely need them: a modal overlay and a toast. Everything else stays flat.

This is a system for scrolling at speed. The user's thumb is the primary input device. Buttons are large enough to tap, transitions are fast enough to never feel like waiting, and loading states are skeletons, not spinners. Content loads, the user reacts, the feed moves on.
keyCharacteristics: One sans-serif family (Noto Sans SC) at five weights, no display/body split
Pink accent on ≤10% of any screen; its rarity is the point
140–160ms transitions with expo-out easing; no orchestrated choreography
Cards distinguished by tone (white on warm tint), not shadow
8px–20px radius scale; softer corners than a pure terminal, sharper than consumer social apps
Mobile-first with a bottom tab bar; desktop gets a 220px sidebar

rules.name: The 10% Rule
rules.body: The blush pink accent covers ≤10% of any screen at rest. Its scarcity is what makes it signal 'interactive.' A screen where pink appears on more than two elements has lost its restraint.

rules.name: The Tone-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels are distinguished from the page background by tonal contrast (white surface on warm-tinted bg), not by box-shadow. Shadows exist for two exceptions: modals/drawers (shadow-lg) and toasts (shadow-lg). Card hover uses shadow-sm at most.

rules.name: The No-All-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is prohibited on body text, labels, and buttons. The only exceptions: the logo wordmark and single-character avatar initials. Lowercase and sentence case read faster at scroll speed.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: One sans-serif. No serif display, no secondary sans, no handwritten accent. The personality comes from the pink, not the font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows are applied only as a response to state (hover, modal overlay, toast). If a card has a permanent shadow, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Ceiling
rules.body: Only two distinct shadow tokens (--shadow for hover, --shadow-lg for overlay). No intermediate values, no custom one-off shadows. If --shadow-lg isn't enough, the element doesn't need more shadow; it needs a different elevation strategy (backdrop blur or darker scrim).

dos: Do use the pink accent on ≤10% of any screen. Primary buttons, active nav, focus rings, links. Nothing else.
Do distinguish cards from the background via tonal contrast (white on warm tint), not box-shadow. Shadows are for hover and overlay states only.
Do use 140–160ms expo-out transitions for interactive state changes. Speed is part of the personality.
Do use skeleton loaders for all async content. The shimmer animation signals 'content is coming' without breaking the feed's visual rhythm.
Do use the single Noto Sans SC family for all text. Hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/600/700/800) and size, not font changes.
Do keep the feed dense. Author info, stats, and actions pack into a compact card. Information-rich without feeling cluttered — the B站 lesson.
Do make every interactive element respond to hover, focus, active, and disabled states. A button without :active feedback feels broken.
donts: Don't use box-shadow on static cards. Cards are flat at rest. If a card needs to stand out, use a border or a background tint.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis comes from weight and size, not decorative fills.
Don't use glassmorphism or backdrop-filter blur for decorative effect. The feed is the content; the chrome is invisible.
Don't add all-caps labels, eyebrow text, or numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03). This is not a marketing page.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent) on cards or callouts. Use full-border, background tint, or nothing.
Don't invent new button styles per screen. Primary, ghost, and danger are the only three. Consistency beats creativity.
Don't use spinners in content areas. Skeleton loaders only. Spinners are for full-page initial loads.
Don't let pink appear on more than two non-content elements at once. If the sidebar nav, a card action, and a focus ring are all pink simultaneously, the accent has lost its signal value.
Don't design for desktop first. The mobile bottom-tab + scroll layout is the primary experience. Desktop sidebar is an enhancement, not the default.
Don't use enterprise/admin dashboard aesthetics: gray tables, form-heavy layouts, conservative typography, muted palettes. This is B站, not Jira.
